mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO rises > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 2%, the combination signals a potential stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% in one month, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where HOUST declines > 10% YoY and UNRATE rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of economic expansion, a sharp increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% QoQ signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 rises > 2% QoQ during economic expansion.
